Evolvantur antiquorum fæculorum annales, ac
ubique inveniemus, nihil esse quod iram Dei magis
contrahat, quam ut Dei cultus & ecclesiæ
profanentur; ac in eorum manus incidant qui
sefmet mundo vendiderunt, ac politicis principum
negotiis manciparunt: ubicunque hoc receptum
fuit, certa & evidens demonstratio est mutatio-
nis in regimine, ac miseriarum & infamiæ eorum
qui potestate illa abutuntur; deprehendetur etiam
eorum res in pejora semper ruere.
Neque est quod vobis in memoriam revoce-

rum & fortissimorum vestrorum Regum, cum
vestris Archiepiscopis in Anglia ipsa, ut in herba
supprimerent papatum illum quem sibi inter vos
vendicabant, ut videlicet nisi horum arbitrio
non liceret regibus ipsis regnare. Qui in præsentia pe-
ricula oculos ferio conjiciunt, neque ignorant qui
sint, mali quod intenditur, authores, facile per-

page.notes: Printed page 487 is a right-hand page of a folio-style running text in two-page spread; only one page visible. Running head reads "IN REGNO SCOTIÆ." with date 1640 and page number 487 at top. Doubtful readings: "mifera" (line 4) and "fubditis" may be misread; "ut agnofceremus" rendered as printed "agnofceremus". Words "ut" in "ut in herba" and "fupprimerent" are as printed. Last visible word "experien-" is cut off at the foot by the signature line; the continuation is not on this page. Section "Hh 4" is the signature mark; a catchword "tiâ" is printed at lower right and omitted as it is a catchword fragment.
